text:
You need a mobile app that pairs a Metahuman presence with emotionally responsive, multilingual ChatGPT-style conversations in a way that feels natural and human-like.

I’m Noor Halden, and I have 6 years of experience building NLP and machine learning systems with Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, XGBoost, and pandas. In a recent project, I built a WhatsApp and SMS delivery support chatbot for Parcelwise Logistics; it resolved 43% of conversations without an agent. I also built a support ticket triage model for Kettlewell Support Co. that improved macro-F1 to 0.88 and cut median routing time from 6 hours to 4 minutes.

For MQA AI, I’d focus on the conversation layer, emotional response logic, multilingual handling, and integration planning around the Metahuman experience. Which part of the app is the current priority: voice emotion, multilingual chat, or the character interaction flow?
